nits: Opening hours are written twice, in the visit.html table and in HOURS in js/home.js. The README says to change both together, but nothing checks that they match.
The home page's 'Coming up' event is hard-coded HTML and will be out of date after 5 December 2026. It could be generated from the events data instead.
The home page's 'Open today' line uses the visitor's local time zone, not the shop's (UK) time, so it can name the wrong day for visitors abroad.
The playwright devDependency range ^1.63.0 lets a plain npm install pull a newer version (the latest is 1.65.1) than the global 1.63.0 the tests were run against.

report:
I found nothing that needs fixing before merge. This PR can go in.

**What I ran and checked**
- **Tests:** `npm test` passes all 35 (Node test runner with Playwright driving headless Chrome).
- **Coverage of the issue:**
  - **Pages:** all four exist, with `index.html` at the repo root, and every page has the same nav with `aria-current` on the current page.
  - **Books:** 15 books in 5 genres. You can filter by genre, the choice is saved in the URL, and Back and Forward restore it. Odd URL values work: lowercase genre names match, `History & Place` survives the round trip, and an unknown or script-like value falls back to "All genres". Book text is set with `textContent`, so nothing from the URL is inserted as HTML.
  - **Events:** five events, all dated after today (2026-11-17). Each weekday matches its date; I checked them with `date -d`.
  - **Visit:** the hours table, the address, and a contact form. The form has a labelled error for each field, sets `aria-invalid`, moves focus to the first invalid field, reports through a `role="status"` live region, and says it is a demo that sends nothing.
  - **No network:** no CDNs or web fonts, there is no build step, and a test asserts that pages make no requests outside their own origin.
- **Small screens:** my own probe at 360px, with the pages opened straight from disk (`file://`), showed `scrollWidth` 360 on all four pages and no console errors. The test suite also covers 360px at 200% text size, and 320px for the hours table.
- **Colour contrast:** I computed every colour pair and all pass. The lowest is the yellow focus outline on the current nav link at 4.54:1; the rule for focus outlines is 3:1. Muted text on the background is 7.45:1, links 6.82:1, error text 7.69:1, and white on the nav highlight 6.55:1.
- **Repo conventions:** the base commit is an empty fixture, so there were no existing conventions to break.
- **README:** what it says matches the code. For example, Playwright is found in local `node_modules` before the global `NODE_PATH`, and opening the files from disk works.

`git status` is the same as when I started. I only wrote to a scratch directory from `mktemp -d`.
